summary:
Project Summary – Abandoned but Not Forgotten

Our project, “Abandoned but Not Forgotten,” aims to spread awareness about abandoned places and help people understand their history, importance, and stories. We have created an informative website that makes learning easy and engaging for everyone. The website includes a Notes section for important information, an educational video for visual understanding, and an interactive quiz to test users’ knowledge. Our goal is to make information accessible, encourage curiosity, and remind people that abandoned places still hold valuable stories worth remembering.
details: Project Name: Abandoned but Not Forgotten 1. What does it do or how does it work? Our project is an educational website that helps people understand abandoned places, their history, importance, and stories. It includes a Notes section, an educational video, and an interactive quiz to make learning simple and interesting. 2. What benefits does it have? - Makes learning easy and accessible. - Spreads awareness about abandoned places. - Provides information through notes and videos. - Improves knowledge through interactive quizzes. - Encourages curiosity and exploration. 3. What is the intended impact of the project? Our aim is to make people aware of abandoned places, preserve their forgotten stories, and encourage people to understand their historical, cultural, and environmental importance. 4. What tools, coding languages, hardware, or software did you use to develop your project? - HTML – To create the website structure. - CSS – To design and style the website. - JavaScript – To add interactive features and quizzes. - VS Code – For writing and editing code. - Web Browser – For testing the website. - Computer/Laptop – For project development. 5. How is your project creative? Our project combines educational notes, videos, and interactive quizzes on a single platform. Instead of just reading information, users can watch, learn, and test their knowledge. This makes learning more engaging, interactive, and interesting. 6. What factors did your team consider? - Easy-to-use website design. - Simple language for everyone. - Accurate and meaningful information. - Interactive and engaging content. - Accessibility for different users. - Awareness and preservation of forgotten places. - A smooth learning experience. Our Main Goal: To turn forgotten places into remembered stories through technology, education, and awareness.
